description: Searches entity types with the specified criteria and pagination.

name.description: The name of the entity type to search for. Use * to return all entity types.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

orderBy.description: The field to order the results by. Supported values: insertInstant, lastUpdateInstant, name.

startRow.description: The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

name: searchEntityTypesByParametersWithId
